title: Open-Cone Passive Cheer Megaphone
description: One complete static passive cheer megaphone: a thick tapered conical shell with a real broad open mouth, narrow open speaking end and continuous through interior, plus a complete open-loop handgrip bonded beneath the rear cone. Two editable closed solids and three opaque matte PBR roles for exterior, lining and grip. The large mouth is not a flat painted disc and there is no electronic loudspeaker, switch, battery or fictitious powered sound. Not the coiled tube of a bugle or an unrelated fungus with funnel in its name. Newly authored whole cone/lip and finite grip profiles on mature mesh/export tools. Metres, Z up, front -Y, bounds centred, finite grip underside at Z0. Static fixed geometry only; no acoustic gain, electronics, operation, hand fit, manufacture, balance or safety claim.
